name: mcp-api-integration
description: Working rules for the Figma MCP server, the Figma REST API and the Asana MCP server: which writes are safe when OAuth attributes them to the signed-in user, how to parse Figma file keys and node ids, which interface to reach for, how OAuth sessions fail quietly, and how to prove a connection returns real data before relying on it. Sets the Asana ticket convention: numbered tickets with a boxed screenshot of the source, ToDo → In Progress → Dev Testing, and an image-only before/after on completion. Includes a playbook of recipes and dependency-free Figma REST clients in TypeScript and Python.
